runners.comment: Bladey Lady won last time out and has three wins in her last six starts, though an eighth two starts back shows she can flop, and she has run over today's trip. Carrying 135 lb from draw 2 after 27 days off, she sits fifth of eight on our rating.

By Jove Grace arrives in cracking nick, a winner last time out, with a second two starts back, and she has run over today's trip and going before. Our rating of 82 puts her top of the eight, and 36 days off is the only slight query, while 134 lb is a notable burden.

Bai Tong has run over today's trip and on this going, and her second three starts back shows she can go close, while 39 days off should have her fresh. Two sevenths since are the concern, and she's yet to win in her last four starts, though our rating of 72 ranks her third of eight from stall 1.

Water Angel went close with a second last time out after a fourth and a fifth, though he is yet to win in his last three starts and returns after 46 days off. He has run over today's trip and runs from stall 4, but our rating of 65 ranks him sixth of eight.

Or Another comes here in decent heart after a second last time out, and he has run over today's trip and on the going before, while our rating of 71 ranks him fourth of eight. The risk is consistency, as a ninth two starts back sits among a winless run in his last six.

Cheeky Chesca has a win three starts back and two thirds before that, and she has run over today's trip, while our rating of 74 ranks her second of eight. The main risk is a sixth and then an unplaced run in her last two outings, so she must bounce back from 24 days off.

Profitability is winless in her last four, unplaced last time and a fifth four starts back, and she returns after 55 days off, so she is hard to fancy. A third two starts back and experience of today's trip are in her favour, and she carries 122 lb from draw 6.

Lord Bishop is hard to fancy, having finished eighth last time out, a ninth two starts back and unplaced three runs ago, so he is winless in recent starts. On the plus side, he has run over today's trip and is back after 15 days, but our rating ranks him last of eight.

racecards.verdict: By Jove Grace heads the field on our figures with a rating of 82, a clear eight pounds better than Cheeky Chesca on 74, and that gap should count for plenty in a modest Class 5 sprint on soft ground at Catterick. Cheeky Chesca is the chief danger, with Bai Tong and Or Another also close enough to take advantage if our pick fails to reproduce her best over the six furlongs. Confidence is low given the open look of the contest, but the rating advantage makes By Jove Grace the logical choice, and she is our selection.

racecards.race_name: Racing In The City Of Tribes Handicap

runners.comment: Winner last time out just nine days ago, with a second three starts back and another four starts back, so he arrives in good heart and has run over today's trip and going. Carrying 140 lb off an official mark of 80 and rated 75 by us, eighth of 15, he looks a midfield sort.

Never Loose won three starts back and has run over today's trip and going, while our rating of 84 ranks her top of the 15. The risk is a seventh last time out and 49 days off, with 140 lb to carry from stall 10.

Amplitude has been in the frame twice in his last six, with thirds four and five starts back, and he's back quickly after eight days, having run over today's trip and going before. Our rating of 83 ranks him second of 15, but he's yet to win and was only seventh last time.

Excuzio Joe arrives in better heart after back-to-back seconds, last time out and two starts back, and she has run over today's trip and going, but she is still winless in her last five and carries 133 lb off an official 73. Our rating of 80 puts her seventh of 15, a midfield profile from draw 5.

Fifth last time out and a second five starts back show some ability, but this filly is winless in her last five and has finished eighth and seventh in between. She has run over today's trip and returns after 17 days, though 132 lb from draw 4 is a stiff ask.

Flying Fortress is winless in his last six, unplaced last time and only once in the first three, a second three starts back, so he is hard to fancy. He has run over today's trip and going, is fresh enough after 15 days, and our rating of 74 ranks him 11th of 15 from draw 15.

Our rating of 83 puts Cherry Hill Girl third of 15 and well clear of her official 74, while she's fresh enough after 16 days and has run over today's trip and going. The risk is a form line of unplaced, seventh and a third three starts back, and she's yet to win in her last six.

Lady Arwen won twice in her last six starts, five and six starts back, and was a third two starts back, but she was unplaced last time and has since come back quickly after 12 days. She has run over today's trip and going, though 131 lb from draw 2 and our ninth-ranked rating of 74 point to a midfield chance.

Yet to win in his last three, Stable Lane was second last time out but a sixth, then another sixth, before that, and a 139-day layoff raises fitness doubts. He has run over today's trip and runs off 131 lb from stall nine, but ranking 12th of 15 on our figures makes him hard to fancy.

Earls is yet to win in his last six starts, with a third and a second five and six runs back now giving way to a ninth two starts back and an unplaced run last time out, though he's fit enough after 15 days and has run over today's trip and going. Our rating of 80 sits well above his official 70, but 130 lb from draw 14 is a lot to carry.

San Aer arrives off a 49-day break after back-to-back fifths, with a second three starts back his best recent effort, and he has run over today's trip and going. Yet to win in his last six, he's helped by our 80 rating against an official 69, but a yard in cold form holds him back.

Titanium is our pick on overall profile: he's back quickly after seven days, has run over today's trip and on this going, and his two fifths in recent starts show he can hit the frame's fringes. He's yet to win in his last six, though our rating of 83 points to better from 128 lb off an official 68.

Winless in his last six, Jp's Express is hard to fancy, though a third last time out, just 12 days ago, shows he is in some heart, and he has run over today's trip and going before. Ranked 13th of 15 on our figures, he looks short of the class needed from stall 11.

Aquilla Star is hard to fancy, ranked last of 15 on our figures after a fifth last time out, and her yard is 0/24 lately. In her favour, she won two starts back and has run over today's trip and going before, while drawing stall 1.

Sylkie is winless in her last five, with a seventh last time out and two unplaced runs before that, so she is hard to fancy. In her favour, she has run over today's trip and going, is back after 16 days, and a third five starts back shows she can go close.

racecards.verdict: Titanium sits on a rating of 83, just a pound behind the top-rated Never Loose, and we prefer him on his progressive profile and a fitness edge that should count for plenty in heavy ground over eight furlongs. That sort of underfoot test tends to reward the sharper, improving type, and Titanium fits that description better than his more exposed rivals. Never Loose is the obvious danger as the narrowly higher-rated runner, while Amplitude and Cherry Hill Girl are level with our pick on 83 and cannot be dismissed in a competitive fifteen-runner field. Titanium is the selection.

racecards.race_name: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Novices' Handicap Steeple Chase (Go North Forgive 'N Forget Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Royal Time won last time out and is back quickly after just nine days, with a third two starts back showing consistent recent form. He has run over today's trip and going before, though carrying 164 lb is a reasonable reservation.

Thereyare won last time out and has run over today's trip and going before, making him a leading threat from a rating of 90 on 163 lb. The risk is a 220-day absence, after three modest finishes before that win.

Wearelongterm arrives in fine heart after winning last time out and a third two starts back, and he has run over today's trip and on this going before. The risk is a quick turnaround, just three days since that win, with 161 lb to carry.

Luminaries arrives in cracking nick, a winner last time out and again two starts back, and he has run over today's trip and going, but carrying 155 lb off an official mark of 82 looks a stiff ask. Our figures rank him last of six, so he is hard to fancy.

Our top-rated runner on 89 against an official 75, Joie More has run over today's trip and drops in with a workable 148 lb, but he was pulled up last time and returns after 197 days off, so fitness is the big question.

The Kings Soldier is hard to fancy, having finished fifth in each of his last three starts and remaining winless in his last six, with a 51-day absence adding to the doubt. On the plus side, he has run over today's trip and going, and a third four starts back shows he can get closer.

racecards.verdict: Royal Time is our selection, sharing the top rating of 89 with Joie More but getting the nod on a fitness edge, a progressive profile and a proven record on these conditions. Over a marathon 24 furlongs at Newcastle, that blend of sharpness and a rising trend can make the difference between two evenly rated runners. Joie More is the chief danger on identical figures, while Thereyare, four pounds behind, and Wearelongterm, six back, have the credentials to take advantage if our pick fails to give his running. Royal Time is the choice.

racecards.race_name: Celebrating Helen MacKinnon's LX Years Handicap Stakes (Div I)

runners.comment: Impressor is our top-rated runner, a gelding who has won once in his last six starts and finished third two starts back, with experience of both today's trip and going. He turned out just a day ago after a sixth last time out, which is the one reservation, but our rating of 62 and a speed figure of 64 make him the one to beat from stall six.

Barmyblade has run over today's trip and going before, and a second two starts back, with a winner five starts back, shows he can land a blow, while our rating of 59 ranks him third of ten. The main risk is an eighth last time out, though he returns fresh after 22 days.

Stoneywell is winless in his last six, though a sixth last time out was his best of that run, and he has run over today's trip before. A 69-day break and 134 lb from stall eight temper enthusiasm, with our rating of 56 placing him sixth of ten.

Battenburg Belle won twice in a row two and three starts back before a fourth last time out, and she has run over today's trip and going. Her 35-day break and 133 lb on her back are the main risk, with the rest not ideal for a filly bidding to resume winning ways.

Ottawa is yet to win in his last six starts, though a fifth last time out and a fourth two starts back suggest he's close to his level, and he has run over today's trip and going before. A 36-day break and 132 lb temper enthusiasm, but our rating of 56 puts him fifth of ten.

Stormy Pearl has finished third in three of her last six, including a third three starts back and another four starts back, and has run over today's trip and going, while our rating of 60 ranks her second of ten. The risk is she's yet to win in that spell, and a fifth last time out leaves her something to prove.

Won last time out and has run over today's trip and going, but that is one win in her last six, with a fourth three starts back and an unplaced run two starts back in between. Ranked eighth of ten on our figures and carrying 125 lb from draw 2, she is hard to fancy.

Runner-up last time out and fresh enough after 20 days, Desert Master has run over today's trip and going, but he is yet to win in his last six starts and a seventh and sixth in that spell suggest consistency is lacking. Our rating of 54 ranks him seventh of ten.

Winless in his last five, with a fourth last time out, a seventh and a ninth before that, Blue Jay Way is hard to fancy and sits ninth of ten on our figures. In his favour, he's fresh from a 14-day break and has run over today's trip and going before.

Winless in his last six, Pinpoint was only sixth last time out and returns after 48 days off, though a third and a second in that spell show he can get involved, and he has run over today's trip. Rated 46 by us, he ranks last of ten, so he is hard to fancy.

racecards.verdict: Impressor heads our ratings on 62, and that makes him the one to side with in this Class 6 sprint over six furlongs on soft ground at Catterick. The edge is narrow, two pounds over Stormy Pearl, but it is enough to put him ahead in a field with little to separate the principals. Stormy Pearl is the chief danger on 60, with Barmyblade (59) and Battenburg Belle (57) also close enough to make it a competitive heat. Impressor still looks the most solid option of the group, so he is our selection.

racecards.race_name: Spooktacular Family Day Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle Race

runners.comment: Court Cian arrives with a strong profile, a second last time out and a winner two starts back, with a third and another win before that, and he has run over today's trip and going before. The main risk is a 576-day absence, plus 168 lb on his back.

Consistent in defeat, Mostly Sunny was a third three starts back, with fourths either side of it, and returns just 18 days after an unplaced run, having already tackled today's trip and going. Our rating of 124 makes him the one to beat, despite 166 lb being a stiff burden.

Hard Dealt has finished second in three of her last five, including a second two starts back, and has run over today's trip and going before; our figures rank her fourth of nine. The main risk is 187 days off the track while carrying 165 lb.

Winner last time out and with a trainer in form (6 from 22 in the last 14 days), Mr Mackay has the profile of a leading threat, and he has run on today's going before. The one concern is a 582-day absence, so fitness is the question mark.

Crystal Glance bounced back with a second last time out after a pulled up and a fall, and she has run over today's trip and going before, but 42 days off and a 163 lb burden temper the case. Our rating of 114 ranks her sixth of nine.

Third last time out, and a winner four and five starts back, but Speed Davis has since managed only a sixth and a fifth before that return to form, and 53 days off is a layoff. He has run over today's trip and going, carries 163 lb, and our rating of 115 ranks him fifth of nine.

Buzz Iceclear has slipped to a sixth last time out and an eighth before that, and returns after 224 days off, so he is hard to fancy under 160 lb. In his favour, he won twice earlier in his last five starts and has run over today's trip and going.

Fresh from a win last time out and a third two starts back, Glance of Glory has run over today's trip and is back after 24 days, but he carries 157 lb, and our rating of 113 ranks him just seventh of nine, so he's hard to fancy.

Hard to fancy after 226 days off, with a fifth last time out following a win two starts back, and he carries 154 lb off an official mark of 103. In his favour, he has run over today's trip and going before, and a second came three starts back.

racecards.verdict: Mostly Sunny heads our ratings on 124, four pounds better than Court Cian, and that edge looks worth having in a nine-runner Class 4 over a stamina-testing 23 furlongs on good to soft ground. The gap is a solid rather than overwhelming one, but it is enough to make him the one to beat. Court Cian is the most obvious danger, while Mr Mackay and Hard Dealt, both on 116, are the others who could make it competitive if Mostly Sunny is not at his best. Mostly Sunny gets the nod.

runners.comment: Nobotheratall has run over today's trip and on the going, and he's fresh from an 11-day turnaround, though a winner six starts back and a second five starts back sit behind three modest finishes. Our top-rated runner at 104 against an official 100, he looks the one to beat despite carrying 168 lb.

Our third-ranked runner of eleven, Alidam steps up with a third three starts back as his best recent finish, and he sits on an official mark of 94 with 162 lb. Yet to win in his last five, he is unplaced last time and returns after 142 days off, which is the main risk.

Bodygroove has run over today's trip and going before, and our rating of 98 puts him second of 11, well clear of his official 88 off 156 lb, with a fresh-enough 22 days since his last run. The risk is plain: he is yet to score in his last four, unplaced last time and a sixth three starts back his best effort.

Fourth last time out and a third three starts back show Thesoldiersminit is running with credit, and he has run over today's trip and going, but he is yet to win in his last five starts. Carrying 155 lb off 87 is a stiff ask, and our rating of 89 ranks him only sixth of eleven.

National Question has been below his best lately, a fifth last time out and a sixth before that, and he returns after 136 days off carrying 154 lb off a mark of 86. Two wins in his last five and experience over today's trip and going count for something, but our rating of 80 ranks him ninth of eleven.

Our rating of 92 against an official 85 makes Ms Cindy Kate a leading danger, and she has run over today's trip and going before, with a fourth two starts back and another fourth three starts back. The risk is a 171-day absence after being pulled up last time out, with 153 lb to carry.

Plane Sailing is winless in his last four, with a seventh last time out following two pulled-up efforts, though he has run over today's trip and going before and returns after 34 days. Carrying 153 lb off an official mark of 85, he looks a midfield sort, ranked eighth of 11 on our rating.

Paragon has finished fourth in two of his last three outings and is winless in his last five, though a 140-day break raises fitness questions. He has run over today's trip and on this going, and our rating of 89 sits above his official 86, but 153 lb is a big burden.

Cawthorne Cracker arrives in cracking recent form, second last time out and a winner two starts back, and he has run over today's trip and going before. However, he carries 152 lb off an official mark of 84, and our rating of 78 ranks him tenth of eleven, so he is hard to fancy.

Bouboule has finished fifth in each of his last two starts and is back quickly after seven days, with experience of today's trip and going, but he's yet to win in his last five and carries 144 lb off 77. Our rating of 91 ranks him fifth of 11, so he's a midfield type.

Zeezee is winless in her last five and was eighth last time out, now returning after 299 days off, so she's hard to fancy; two seconds earlier in that run of form and prior experience of today's trip and going are the positives, though 142 lb is a big ask.

racecards.verdict: Nobotheratall heads our ratings at 104, a clear six pounds ahead of Bodygroove and Alidam on 98, and that cushion over the next best is the foundation of the case at Newcastle over 17 furlongs. The two on 98 are the obvious dangers, with Ms Cindy Kate a further six pounds back on 92 but still capable of getting involved if the pace falls her way. With a sizeable gap to the chasing pack and a field of 11 that looks short of a standout beyond the leading trio, Nobotheratall is the one to side with, and the pick is Nobotheratall.

racecards.race_name: Celebrating Helen Mackinnon's LX Years Handicap Stakes (Div II)

runners.comment: Knicks is yet to win in his last six, but he arrives fit after 22 days, finished a fourth last time out, and has run over today's trip and going before. Our rating of 62 tops the field against his official 58, making him the one to beat from stall 10.

Winless in her last five, Sweet Desire was unplaced last time out and has finished sixth and eighth before that, so she is hard to fancy. She has run over today's trip and is fit enough after 19 days, but 134 lb from draw 2 is a lot, and our rating of 42 ranks her ninth of ten.

Winter Crown has finished seventh, sixth, eighth and ninth in his last four runs, yet he has run over today's trip and going before, and our rating of 58 ranks him second of ten. The main risk is that he is winless in recent starts and 36 days off, carrying 134 lb from stall 1.

Chasing a hat-trick after winning last time out and two starts back, My Mate Mackley arrives fit from a 21-day break and has run over today's trip and going before. The main risk is that he carries 132 lb off an official mark of 56.

Profiteer has run over today's trip and going, and our rating of 53 ranks him third of ten, while a light 126 lb and a 27-day break suggest he's fresh enough to outrun his form. The main risk is a ninth last time out, with nothing better than a fifth five starts back.

Suzette is yet to win in her last five starts, with a sixth last time out and a third five starts back, but she has run over today's trip and going and our rating of 53 sits above her official 48. Carrying 125 lb from stall four after 32 days off, she looks a midfield type.

Eldeyaar was beaten into ninth last time out, but he was third two starts back and second three runs ago, and he has run over today's trip and going, back quickly after 12 days. Yet to win in his last six, he sits sixth of ten on our rating, off 125 lb from stall five.

Ski Angel is winless in her last six, though two seconds two and three starts back show she can get involved, and she has run over today's trip and going. A fifth last time out, 15 days ago, and a 45 figure ranking her eighth of ten make her hard to fancy off 124 lb.

Consistent without cracking it, Container Express has been fifth last time out, a fourth two starts back and a third three starts back, and has run over today's trip and going. A 222-day layoff and no win in his last five starts hold him back, though 47 on our rating sits close to his official 48.

Winless in her last six, Mayflower Rock was sixth last time out, a fourth two starts back and another fourth three starts back, so she's hard to fancy and ranks last of ten on our rating of 41. She has run over this trip and on this going and is back quickly after seven days, but 122 lb from stall seven offers little extra.

racecards.verdict: Knicks looks the right one to side with in this Catterick sprint, as our top-rated runner on 62 and four pounds better than his nearest rival, which is a worthwhile edge in a modest Class 6 contest on soft ground. Winter Crown is the main danger on 58, while Profiteer and My Mate Mackley, both on 53, head a tightly packed group that has to find improvement to bridge the gap. With the rest of the field rated 52 or lower, Knicks has the clearest path to victory over six furlongs. Knicks is our selection.

runners.comment: Melchizedek arrives fresh enough after 19 days off, having finished fifth last time out, and he has run over today's trip, while our rating of 71 ranks him fourth of seven. The main risk is that he is winless in his last three starts, with two unplaced efforts before that fifth.

Wecouldavehaditall comes in fresh enough after 22 days, with a third two starts back showing she can get involved, and she has run over today's trip; our 81 ranks her third of seven. The risk is a winless run in her last five, with a sixth last time out.

Gabby Hayes comes here fresh from a run just 11 days ago, with a third two starts back and experience of today's trip and going, while our rating of 82 ranks him second of seven. The main risk is that he's yet to win in his last five starts and was unplaced last time out.

Miss Cornelia has been unplaced last time out, then a seventh two starts back and a sixth three starts back, and she returns after 58 days, but she has run over today's trip and our rating of 88 puts her top of the seven. Off an official 67 from draw 3, she looks the one to beat despite being winless in recent starts.

Knockraha Pa is winless in his last three, unplaced each time, and returns after 20 days with little to suggest a turnaround. He has run over today's trip and our rating of 65 is only a shade above his official 63, but sixth of seven is hard to ignore.

Darlene is winless in her last three, with a sixth last time out, another sixth two starts back and an unplaced effort before that, so she is hard to fancy. She has run over today's trip and is fresh enough after 23 days, but she is rated seventh of seven on our figures.

Winless in his last five, Silk Twist was eighth last time out just eight days ago and has been unplaced or beaten in every recent run, though he has run over today's trip and going before. Our rating of 67 sits well above his official 56, but he ranks only fifth of seven on our figures.

racecards.verdict: Miss Cornelia heads our ratings on 88, six pounds clear of Gabby Hayes on 82 and seven ahead of Wecouldavehaditall on 81, which is an edge over seven furlongs on heavy ground at Galway. Gabby Hayes and Wecouldavehaditall are the obvious dangers and sit close enough together to keep the pick honest, while Melchizedek, a further ten pounds back on 71, is the other danger to note. With the rest of the field rated 67 or lower, Miss Cornelia looks the one to beat even if confidence is only modest, and she is our selection.

racecards.race_name: Sunday Lunch At The Border Minstrel Novices' Limited Handicap Steeple Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Dunkerque has finished in the first three in all six recent runs, including three wins in his last six starts, and was third last time out, then second, then a winner three starts back. He has run over today's trip and going before, and although 35 days off and 164 lb are small queries, our rating of 131 makes him the one to beat.

Kent de Thaix won two starts back and five starts back, and has run over today's trip and going before, while our rating of 124 ranks him second of five. The main risk is a 193-day absence, with a sixth last time out and 154 lb to carry.

Silver Hill arrives in cracking form, a winner last time out, a second two starts back, another second three starts back, and a win four starts back, and he has run on today's going before. The big risk is a 223-day absence, and he carries 153 lb.

Sleedagh is winless in his last five and was only fifth last time, after a ninth, so it is hard to fancy him. In his favour, he has run over today's trip and going, and has three podium finishes in that spell, though he carries 146 lb.

Rocheval has run over today's trip and a fourth two starts back, then another fourth three starts back, show he can be competitive, while our rating of 122 ranks him fourth of five; the risk is a 193-day absence after being pulled up last time out, carrying 145 lb.

racecards.verdict: Dunkerque is the one to side with in this five-runner staying contest at Newcastle, as our top-rated runner on 131 and a full 7 lb better than Kent de Thaix and Silver Hill, who share 124 between them. That is a meaningful advantage over a marathon 24 furlongs on good ground, where class and stamina tend to tell. Kent de Thaix and Silver Hill look the chief dangers, with Rocheval a little further back on 122, while Sleedagh looks outclassed on 115. Dunkerque should be too good, and he is our selection.

racecards.race_name: Remembering Kevin Lumb AKA Burnley Kevin Handicap Stakes

runners.comment: Winner last time out and again five starts back, Marching Mac is back quickly after seven days and has run over today's trip and going before; our rating of 85 puts him second of eight. The risk is a patchy middle spell, with an eighth and a fifth in the form.

Miraculous was sixth last time out, 10 days ago, and has one win in his last six starts, a victory three starts back, so the form is patchy. He has run over today's trip and carries 138 lb off an official mark of 80 from stall 6, but our rating of 82 only ranks him fifth of eight.

Belsito has won twice in his last six starts, but he's slipped to a fifth two runs back and a seventh last time out, a drift that holds him back. He's quick back after 10 days, has run over today's trip and going, and carries 138 lb from draw 3.

Manila Scouse bounces back from a quiet spell with a second last time out just ten days ago, and he has run over today's trip and on this going before, while our rating of 83 puts him third of eight. The risk is that he is yet to win in his last six, with four unplaced efforts in that stretch.

Homestrait showed a bit of form with a third last time out, and a second five starts back, so she isn't without credentials, plus she has run over today's trip and going and is back quickly after eight days. Still, a poor eighth three starts back and our rating ranking her seventh of eight, with 135 lb to carry from stall seven, make her hard to fancy.

Aberama Gold has been consistent, finishing second three times in his last six starts and fourth last time out four days ago, and he has run over today's trip and going before. Our rating of 86 makes him the one to beat, though he is yet to win in that spell.

Azure Zain has run over today's trip and on the going, and a third two starts back plus a win five starts back show he can pick up a race; our rating of 82 puts him fourth of eight, a leading danger. The main risk is a seventh last time out and 130 lb after 36 days off.

Quercus was unplaced last time out and has only the one win in his last five starts, a victory two starts back, with fifths and a sixth around it. He has run over today's trip and going and is fresh enough after ten days, but our rating has him ranked eighth of eight.

racecards.verdict: Aberama Gold heads the field on our ratings at 86, narrowly ahead of Marching Mac on 85, and that small edge is enough to make him the pick in a tightly packed Class 4 sprint at Catterick. Over six furlongs on soft ground, the line-up is bunched, so a pound or so could decide it. Marching Mac is the chief danger, with Manila Scouse on 83 and Azure Zain on 82 also in the mix. Aberama Gold gets the nod to edge out that trio.

racecards.race_name: Kellyhill Financial Planning Mares' Handicap Hurdle Race (Challenger Mares' Hurdle Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Betty's Daisy is our pick on profile: she won three starts back, followed it with a second, and has run over today's trip and going before, while carrying 170 lb. The reservation is a 220-day absence and a pulled-up effort last time out.

Masked Dance bounced between a win and two seconds earlier in her last five, and has run over today's trip and going before, while our rating of 126 ranks her second of ten; the concern is a 165-day absence after a fifth and a sixth in her last two outings.

I Spy A Diva was third last time out, and a fourth two starts back, and she has run over today's trip and going before. Our rating has her top of ten, though 299 days off and 164 lb are the main risk.

Edith Pelham won two starts back and has run over today's trip and going, but she was eighth last time out and returns after 220 days off, carrying 161 lb. Our rating of 115 puts her fifth of ten, so she looks a midfield sort.

Hornica won last time out and was third two starts back, but a 191-day break is a concern, and she has run on today's going before. Carrying 161 lb off an official mark of 113, she looks a midfield sort, and our rating ranks her seventh of ten.

Winner last time out and second in her two runs before that, Iamyouare arrives fit after 26 days and has run over today's trip and going, but she carries 158 lb and our rating of 114 only ranks her sixth of ten.

Crystal Spring has strong recent form, winning three starts back and finishing second two starts back, and she has run over today's trip and going before, while our rating of 117 ranks her fourth of ten. The main risk is a 314-day absence, plus 156 lb and a sixth last time out.

Without a win in her last four starts, Hot Goddess is hard to fancy after 269 days off, though a second last time out and prior experience over today's trip and going count in her favour. Carrying 155 lb, she is ranked eighth of ten on our figures.

Queen Maeve won last time out and was third three starts back, but that came 185 days ago, and she carries 153 lb off an official rating of 107. Our rating of 99 ranks her last of ten, so the layoff makes her hard to fancy.

Laysoft's form tailed off with a fifth last time out, and she returns after 243 days off, which is hard to ignore under 146 lb. She has run over today's trip and going, and a third two starts back, then a second, shows she can still hit the frame.

racecards.verdict: Betty's Daisy is our selection, and her progressive profile is the reason to side with her over the top-rated I Spy A Diva, who is only five pounds ahead on our figures. At 122 she sits comfortably third in our ratings and has the look of a mare still improving, which counts for plenty over this 20-furlong trip on good to soft ground. I Spy A Diva and Masked Dance, just a pound apart at the head of the ratings, are the obvious dangers, with Crystal Spring next best of the rest. This looks an open contest, so the call is a lean rather than a strong one, but Betty's Daisy is the one to be with.

Dogs Welcome At The Border Minstrel Pub Handicap Hurdle Race (Go North Sea Pigeon Series Qualifier)

Fourth last time out and only nine days ago, Max of Stars keeps busy and has run over today's trip and going, while a second three starts back shows she can get close. Yet to win in her last five, and 166 lb is the main risk.

Jentobello won last time out and has finished in the first four in each of his last five starts, with 23 days since that win and experience of today's trip and going. Carrying 164 lb is the main risk, and our rating of 110 ranks him fourth of six.

Our top-rated runner at 122 despite a patchy book, Pyramid Place has run over today's trip and going before and, though officially rated only 106, he tops our ratings by a clear margin. A 121-day break and two pulled-up efforts in his last three runs are the concern, though.

Third last time out and a winner four starts back, Roarin' Success has sound recent form and has run over today's trip and going, but she carries 157 lb off an official mark of 103. Our figures rank her fifth of six, so she looks hard to fancy.

Without a win in her last five, Hunters Spring is hard to fancy, with a pulled up and an unseated in the last three starts raising doubts over reliability, and she carries 155 lb. On the plus side, she was third last time out and has run over today's trip and going, but our figures rank her sixth of six.

racecards.verdict: Pyramid Place is the choice at Newcastle, as our figures put him 10 lb clear of Max of Stars, a real margin in a six-runner Class 4 contest over 17 furlongs on good ground. That gap gives him the strongest credentials on the book, and he only needs to run to his level to be hard to peg back. Max of Stars is the chief danger, with North of Richmond (111) and Jentobello (110) also closely grouped and capable of improving enough to make it a tight finish, while Roarin' Success and Hunters Spring look to have more to find. Pyramid Place is the selection, though our confidence is low.

racecards.race_name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap Stakes

Gentle George tops our ranking with an 82 and a speed figure of 80, and he has run over today's trip and going, returning after 19 days off; the risk is a winless run of six, last seen finishing seventh, from 138 lb off an official 74.

Havana Rum showed his form with a fourth last time out, and another fourth two starts back, and he returns fresh enough after 15 days, having run over today's trip and going before. Our rating of 80 backs the pick, though he is yet to win in his last six starts.

Fresh after just 11 days, The Resdev Scholar has run over today's trip and on this going, and our rating of 79 ranks him third of 15, though he's winless in his last six and comes here off an eighth and a seventh.

Decem Starr was second last time out and has run over today's trip, but he's winless in his last five and a fourth four starts back is his next best finish. A 31-day break and a yard struggling at 1/20 temper enthusiasm, while 136 lb from stall 12 asks plenty.

Swift Salian has run over today's trip and going and comes back after 22 days, but he's winless in his last six, with a fifth and a fourth before an unplaced run last time. Our rating of 72 sits a few pounds above his official 69, though 135 lb is a hefty burden.

Wobwobwob was third last time out and has run over today's trip and going, though he is yet to win in his last six starts and returns just four days later. Our rating of 75 ranks him fifth of 15, a touch above his official mark of 68, carrying 134 lb from stall 14.

Black Storm has gone eighth and ninth in his last two starts, though he won four starts back and was third before that, and he's fresh enough after 15 days. He has run over today's trip and going, but 133 lb from draw 5 and a middling rating of 71 make him a mid-pack proposition.

The Gay Blade has been beaten in five of his last six, with a fourth last time out the best of them since a win six starts back, and a seventh and an eighth before that. He has run over today's trip and going and is fresh enough after ten days, but 133 lb from stall one and a 13th-of-15 ranking make him hard to fancy.

Runner-up last time out and a winner two starts back, this gelding is in solid recent form and back quickly after just ten days, having run over today's trip and going before. Carrying 132 lb from stall four, he's rated 71 by us, only eighth of 15, which suggests he may need to improve again.

Evocative Spark has finished sixth, fifth, ninth, seventh and fourth since a win six starts back, so the trend is hard to like, though he has run over today's trip and going before and returns after 27 days. Carrying 131 lb from stall eight, he is ranked 14 of 15 on our figures.

Highfield Viking was unplaced last time out and has only one win in his last six starts, a victory two starts back, which makes him hard to fancy, ranked 11th of 15 on our figures. On the plus side, he is back quickly after 11 days and has run over today's trip and going before.

Another Investment is winless in his last six, with back-to-back ninth-place finishes and a second six starts back the best of that run, though he's only ten days since his last outing and has run over today's trip and going. Our rating of 71 sits above his official 65, but carrying 131 lb from stall 13 leaves plenty to prove.

Surprised is winless in her last six, with unplaced efforts on her last two outings and a seventh three starts back, so she is hard to fancy at 127 lb from stall 15. In her favour, she has run over today's trip and on the going, and a third five starts back shows some ability.

Penny Ghent has been unplaced in her last two starts and won six starts back, so she's hard to fancy at the foot of our ratings (15th of 15). On the plus side, she's back quickly after 11 days and has run over today's trip and going.

racecards.verdict: Havana Rum is our selection for this 7f Class 5 on soft ground at Catterick, and the progressive profile is what we like most, with the sort of upward trajectory that can overturn a narrow rating gap. Our figures put him at 80, just two pounds behind Gentle George on 82, so there is very little between them and the improver can reverse that. Gentle George is the chief danger as the top-rated runner, while The Resdev Scholar on 79 and Mister Sox on 76 are also within range in a wide-open 15-runner field. Havana Rum gets the vote, though this is a competitive contest.

racecards.race_name: Mount Vines Novices' Handicap Steeple Chase (GBB Race)

Mahland has won twice in his last five starts, including a victory two starts back, and he carries 167 lb with our ratings ranking him second of 14. The big risk is a 559-day absence, and he was pulled up last time out.

Laughing John won two starts back and three starts back, but he was unplaced last time out and returns after 182 days off. He has run over today's trip and going, and carries 166 lb off an official mark of 118, while our rating of 121 ranks him fourth of 14.

Sign Again has run over today's trip and going and was third two starts back, while our rating of 122 ranks him third of 14 and sits above his official 117, so he's a leading threat. The risk is a 242-day absence and an unseated rider last time out, with 165 lb to carry.

Won last time out and has two wins in her last five starts, with a second and a third in that spell, and she has run over today's trip and going before; a 186-day absence and a hefty 165 lb hold her back, and our rating of 117 ranks her ninth of 14.

Kel du Large looks a leading threat, having won three starts back and been second two runs ago, while our rating of 123 ranks him top of 14 and he has run over today's trip and going. The risk is a 204-day absence and an unseated rider last time out.

Second last time out and a winner two starts back, so the form reads well, and he has run over today's trip and going before. Against that, he's off 210 days and carries 160 lb, while our rating of 119 ranks him only seventh of 14.

Joeybottles has a win two starts back, but he was only fifth last time out and returns after 187 days off, which makes him hard to fancy under 157 lb. He has run over today's trip and going, and our figures still rank him 13th of 14.

Douglas Hyde is winless in his last five and was eighth last time out, after a long 221-day absence that raises fitness doubts, though he was second two and three starts back and has run on today's going. Carrying 156 lb, he is hard to fancy, and our figures rank him last of 14.

racecards.verdict: Top Guy looks the call in a tightly packed Class 4 over 20 furlongs at Bangor-on-Dee, where fitness and a progressive profile count for plenty on the good to soft ground. He is rated 118, only a few pounds behind the top-rated Kel du Large on 123, and that gap is easily bridged by a horse who arrives sharper and still improving. Kel du Large is the obvious danger, with Mahland and Sign Again, both on 122, only narrowly behind him and the other key dangers. Top Guy's sharpness and upward trajectory give him the edge in a field of 14, so he is our selection.

Tai Tam Bay is the obvious danger as the highest-rated runner, with La Tulipe Noire and God Knows also close enough to take advantage if our pick fails to progress again, though this looks a competitive contest. Buttermere Ridge is the selection.

Balking and Humble Jumble (96) are the most likely to make it competitive, while Rule Me In (93) is another who could take a hand if the principal fluffs his lines. Loulou Madrik is the selection.

Habari is a leading danger on our figures, ranked third of twelve and back quickly after 11 days, with experience of today's going and an official rating of 54. The risk is a run of finishes of seventh, eighth and seventh, leaving him winless in his last five starts.

Ebony Maw has finished in the first four in five of his last six, including a win five starts back, and has run over today's trip and going before. A fourth last time out and a slide to sixth two starts back are the worry, along with 134 lb.

Golden Samba is winless in her last six, unplaced last time and a seventh two starts back, so she is hard to fancy at 127 lb off a mark of 43. In her favour, she has run over today's trip and on this going, and a third six starts back shows some ability.

Winless in his last five, Lion City was seventh last time out, a sixth two starts back, and returns after 239 days off, which makes him hard to fancy. He has run over today's trip and our rating has him last of twelve, though an official mark of 42 offers a little hope.

Masterpiece is winless in his last four, unplaced last time and a sixth two starts back, with only a third four starts back to cling to. A 28-day break is fine and an official mark of 34 is modest, but our figures rank him ninth of twelve, so he's hard to fancy.

racecards.verdict: Rock On Pedro heads our ratings on 69, a clear five pounds ahead of Bollin Neil on 64, and that cushion is the strongest argument for him in a Class 6 contest over two miles on soft ground at Catterick. The bottom half of the field is rated below this level, so the contest should revolve around the first four in our figures, and Rock On Pedro is the pick.

Locquirec is a leading danger on our figures, ranked fourth of nine, and a third five starts back shows he can reach the places. The main risk is a 192-day absence, with a sixth last time out and a fell two starts back hardly screaming sharpness.

Riviera Walk won three starts back and has run over today's trip and going, while our rating of 120 ranks her second of nine, making her a leading threat off 166 lb. The main risk is a patchy record, unseating last time out and returning from 174 days off.

Falco des Pins arrives in cracking recent form, a second last time out and a winner two and three starts back, and he has run over today's trip and going. The drawbacks are a 227-day absence and 165 lb on his back, while our rating of 104 ranks him only fifth of nine.

Laristote showed he's in good heart with a third last time out, and a third four starts back shows he can hit the frame, while our 117 puts him third of nine and he has run over today's trip. The one big risk is a 192-day absence, plus 163 lb is a hefty burden.

racecards.verdict: Inedit d'Amour looks the one to beat at Bangor-on-Dee, topping our ratings on 126 and sitting a significant 6 lb clear of Riviera Walk on 120, which is a meaningful edge in a Class 5 over 18 furlongs on good to soft. Ballybawn Belter arrives fresh from a win last time out, 22 days ago, and has a second three starts back too, so she's in good heart and has run over today's trip before. Our rating of 82 ranks her third of 11, but a sixth two starts back shows she can have an off day.

Royal Saxo has finished sixth last time out, a seventh two starts back and a fifth three starts back, so he is yet to win in his last five and hasn't convincingly found his feet; he has run over today's trip and returns after 36 days, while our rating of 76 matches his official mark and sits seventh of 11 at 128 lb.

Ryefield Dasher arrives in cracking nick, a winner last time out and again two starts back, fresh from a 15-day break and having run over today's trip and going. Our rating of 76 ranks him only eighth of 11, though, and 126 lb off an official 80 leaves little margin.

Slurricane has run over today's trip and going, but he's tailed off since winning five starts back, with an eighth last time out and a sixth two starts back. Our rating of 80 sits above his official 74, yet a quiet yard (1/23 lately) and 33 days off temper the case.

Granville Street is yet to win in his last six starts, though a second last time out and a third two starts back show he is in decent heart, and he returns just 12 days later having run over today's trip and going. Ranked ninth of eleven on our figures, he's hard to fancy off 125 lb.

racecards.verdict: Unauthorized shares the top rating of 84 with Mister Adam, and we side with him over that rival on his progressive profile, which should count for plenty in a testing 12 furlongs on heavy ground at Galway. The margins are fine in an 11-runner field, with Mister Adam level on 84 and Ballybawn Belter and Glenroyal only two pounds back on 82, so the danger comes from several directions. Ben Hur is also on 82 and Slurricane not far behind on 80, which keeps this competitive and means confidence is low. Even so, the improving Unauthorized is the one we want on side, and he is our selection.

Consistent sort who has finished in the first four in each of his last six starts, with a fourth last time out following a third, and he has run over today's trip and going, though he has won only once, six starts back.
